app_user.description: System account the application runs as.

app_root.description: Root holding releases/, shared/, and current.

release_id.description: Pinned release identifier. The literal 'latest' is refused.

artifact_url.description: Where the release artifact is fetched from. Checksummed before install.

artifact_sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 of the artifact. A mismatch refuses the install.

app_port.description: Port written into the application environment file.

module_name.description: Dotted module the unit executes with python -m.

service_name.description: systemd unit name to restart. Must match the restart allowlist.

unit_path.description: Where the unit file is written. No subdirectories.

health_url.description: URL polled after the restart. Refused if it points at a metadata address.
